metric_weight.desc: Metric weight (not used by MeasureImageSimilarity; kept for the metric token).

radius_or_number_of_bins.desc: Number of histogram bins for MI and Mattes, or neighbourhood radius for CC.

sampling_strategy.desc: Metric sampling strategy; omitted means dense sampling (one sample per voxel).

sampling_percentage.desc: Fraction of voxels sampled, in (0, 1]; requires sampling_strategy.

fixed_image_mask.desc: Mask limiting the voxels the metric considers, in fixed-image space. MeasureImageSimilarity ignores a mask it cannot read, so the path must exist.

moving_image_mask.desc: Mask in moving-image space; requires fixed_image_mask.
